description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. The role Our Commercial and Revenue Operations teams help power commercial growth by ensuring that customer-facing teams have the right knowledge, skills, processes, systems, data and capabilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive revenue. As a Commercial & Revenue Operations Graduate, you’ll build a broad understanding of the commercial lifecycle while gaining hands-on experience in areas such as Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Deal Management, Commercial Insights and Business Partnering. You may complete rotations across commercial teams before moving into a longer-term placement aligned with your strengths, development interests and business needs. The proposed early careers model includes Commercial Operations, BDR, Account Management and Solutions Engineering pathways. You’ll work alongside experienced professionals, receive structured training and mentoring, and join a global Early Careers community with networking, professional development and leadership opportunities. How you’ll make an impact During the programme, you may: Analyse commercial processes and workflows to identify bottlenecks, risks and opportunities to improve efficiency. Support the design and implementation of scalable processes, playbooks and operating procedures. Use data to identify trends, measure performance and provide clear recommendations to commercial stakeholders. Help maintain accurate CRM and pipeline data, supporting reporting, forecasting and decision-making. Support deal, pricing and approval processes, ensuring information is complete, accurate and well controlled. Create enablement materials, training resources and communications that help commercial teams adopt new tools and ways of working. Explore how AI and automation can improve commercial productivity and operational effectiveness. Partner with teams including Sales, Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers, Product, Engineering, Finance and Data. Contribute to projects that improve the merchant experience and support sustainable revenue growth. What we’re looking for You’re a curious, organised and commercially minded problem-solver who enjoys connecting people, processes and data. You are comfortable learning quickly, asking questions and taking ownership in a fast-paced environment. You’ll bring: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in a quantitative, business, economics, technology or similarly relevant subject. An interest in commercial strategy, revenue operations, sales, fintech or business transformation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into practical recommendations. Intermediate to advanced spreadsheet ability. SQL is a plus. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Strong organisation and attention to detail. An appetite to learn about payments, technology and the commercial lifecycle. Curiosity about AI, automation, data and new ways of working. The ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders. A proactive mindset and willingness to take responsibility for delivering outcomes. Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus. Payments or financial services knowledge is helpful but not required. A keenness to work at pace, managing competing properties effectively and maintaining quality while delivering against tight timelines What success looks like By the end of the programme, you will: Understand how Checkout.com’s commercial teams operate and work together. Be able to analyse a business process, identify improvement opportunities and recommend practical solutions. Demonstrate confidence working with commercial data, systems and reporting. Communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and levels. Deliver projects that create measurable value for commercial teams or customers. Be ready to progress into a permanent role within Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Deal Management, Commercial Insights, Business Development, Account Management or another suitable commercial pathway. Early Careers experience You’ll receive: Dedicated onboarding and payments-focused training. Professional skills workshops and leadership sessions. Mentoring from experienced colleagues. Networking and community events. Opportunities to work on meaningful, business-critical projects. Regular feedback and transparent performance conversations. Potential progression into a permanent role, subject to performance, readiness, headcount availability and business requirements. Our culture We’re looking for people who put the customer first, move with pace, continuously improve, take ownership and maintain high standards of accuracy. Our early careers strategy is designed to develop future payments and commercial experts who can contribute with technical curiosity, commercial awareness and a merchant-focused mindset. Eligibility Graduated within the last 12 months or due to graduate by the programme start date, depending on the selected pathway. Available to work full-time for the duration of the programme. Able to work from the stated programme location and meet applicable right-to-work requirements. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. The Role As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Early Careers Program, we are looking for an ambitious Finance Analyst Apprentice to join our fast-paced EU Finance department. Reporting directly to the Regional Finance Director, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gain hands-on experience, and join a global community with technical training, mentorship, and regular networking opportunities to accelerate your growth. Through a structured three-year program, you will balance real team deliverables with study towards your ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) qualification, dedicating 20% of your time (around six hours per week) to your professional studies. Each placement will be supported by a dedicated Rotation Manager alongside guidance from senior Finance leadership. You will gain broad exposure across six core finance pillars: Financial Control and Revenue & Billing in year one; Tax and Treasury in year two; and Strategic Finance and Finance Transformation in year three. Depending on business and ACCA requirements, you may also gain exposure to adjacent areas such as Product Control, Procurement, or Internal Audit. How You’ll Make An Impact Support accurate, timely finance operations across your rotations, contributing to processes such as month-end close, reconciliations, journals and variance analysis. Help teams deliver invoicing, settlement, revenue recognition, tax compliance, cash management, budgeting and reporting activities. Prepare and review information carefully, including supporting audit, compliance and management reporting requirements. Work with colleagues across Finance to respond to queries, share information and deliver tasks to agreed deadlines. Look for practical ways to improve processes, documentation and the use of finance systems and data. Apply what you learn through ACCA study to real finance work, building technical, analytical and communication skills over time. Eligibility Requirements This role is offered as a government-funded Level 7 ACCA apprenticeship. Appointment is conditional on the successful candidate meeting the government’s apprenticeship funding and eligibility requirements at the start of training, as confirmed by our approved training provider. Under current England funding rules, Level 7 funding is generally available to applicants aged 16–21, with limited exceptions for eligible applicants aged 22–24 who have an EHCP or have been, or are, in care. This role is offered as an early-careers opportunity and we are not able to offer this role on a privately funded basis. Further information about the Apprenticeship funding can be found here. Academic Qualifications: You will have either: A degree qualification OR You have completed a Level 4 AAT qualification before the September start date + 2 A Levels (or equivalent) and 3 GCSEs including a pass in English and Maths Visa sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. What We’re Looking For Academic Ambition: You are eager to begin your journey toward becoming a Chartered Accountant via the ACCA pathway. Analytical Mindset: You have a natural comfort with numbers and a high attention to detail. Resilience: The ability to work toward tight deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment. Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Any prior exposure to accounting systems (like Workday) is a huge plus, but not a dealbreaker—we will train you! Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a "team player" attitude. Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with finance systems such as Workday is helpful, but not essential. description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Le rôle est basé à Lille (France).

Tes principales missions :  

  • Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés sur des zones matures, où l’expertise et l’attention au détail font toute la différence.
  • Développer des partenariats privilégiés et durables en devenant le point de contact expert de votre zone et en mettant à profit vos connaissances Food Tech.
  • Optimiser la performance de vos comptes grâce à un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme et nourri par la data.
  • Analyser les résultats de vos restaurants, identifier les leviers d’amélioration et recommander des actions concrètes à votre manager tout en restant agile et ouvert à la nouveauté.
  • Proposer et mettre en place des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles ciblées pour booster l’attractivité de vos restaurants partenaires.
  • Suivre de près le déroulé des opérations afin de garantir la meilleure expérience restaurant et client possible.

Ton expérience et tes qualités :

  • Tu as déjà 2 à 3 ans d’expérience sur un rôle similaire où la gestion d’un portefeuille de partenaires était centrale à ta mission.
  • Tu sais négocier et anticiper les discussions commerciales tout en gardant à l’esprit les valeurs de Deliveroo.
  • Tu sais garder le contrôle de ton portefeuille, identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché et partager du feedback utile à tes partenaires ainsi qu’à ton manager.
  • Le terrain est un lieu où tu te sens à ta place : tu sais construire des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires tout en gardant un œil attentif sur la concurrence.
  • Tu sais te montrer proactif, analyser les résultats de tes actions et proposer des recommandations concrètes à ton manager.
  • Tu travailles de manière autonome tout en gardant le cap fixé, sais t’approprier des objectifs précis et mets tout en œuvre pour les atteindre.
  • Tu sais concevoir des actions spécifiques, adaptées à la fois aux besoins de tes partenaires et à la stratégie définie par ton manager.
  • Tu sais identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance (commerciales et opérationnelles) pour garantir un niveau de service irréprochable.
  • Tu sais t’exprimer en anglais (à l’oral comme à l’écrit)
  • Tu arrives à convaincre tout en construisant des relations commerciales solides, durables, où Deliveroo devient le partenaire de choix
  • Et si tu cherches un poste où tu travailles en full remote depuis Lille, tout en gardant un lien fort avec le terrain et les équipes, alors c’est peut‑être le rôle qu’il te faut !

La vie chez Deliveroo

Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix.

Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel.

Avantages et diversité

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Deliveroo France valorise la diversité sans discrimination de genre, race, sexualité, religion ou préférences personnelles. Avec un score de 99/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2023, nous sommes engagés envers l'égalité des chances. Rejoignez-nous avec votre passion pour la nourriture dans une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Banking & Markets practice are looking for experienced Consultants & Senior Consultants to join the team. 

Banking and Markets are being reinvented. AI is transforming how institutions operate, customer and regulatory expectations are rising, and established players are under pressure to grow, modernise and perform at pace. Our team works alongside senior leaders at financial institutions to tackle the challenges that matter most - from unlocking new sources of growth and reimagining operating models, to harnessing AI, modernising technology and responding to rapidly changing markets.

Our clients include global transaction, corporate and investment banks, leading high-street banks, building societies, growing digital banking providers and more. You’ll combine strategic thinking and analytical rigour with hands-on delivery experience and an AI-first mindset, helping clients turn complex problems into meaningful, lasting change.

What you will be doing

  • Shaping and delivering large-scale technology, AI and digital transformation programmes, supporting our clients on their transformation journeys.

  • Maximising business value for our clients through the definition and delivery of effective technology, digital, AI and data projects. We see strong demand in the market for pragmatic, delivery-focused consultants who are capable of leading teams, and have the ability to adapt to hybrid delivery models (e.g. Waterfall and Agile).

  • Helping our clients reimagine how their operations will work in an AI age - redesigning processes, operating models and ways of working to drive operational excellence, and balancing the technology change with the people and process change needed to make it stick.

  • Working directly with client stakeholders, building trusted working relationships and supporting effective communication across teams.

 
Your skills and experience

  • Consulting experience (or experience within Banking and Markets organisations) of leading complex transformation for clients, with a strong understanding of AI, emerging technologies and the wider digital ecosystem.

  • Product knowledge in one or more of the following domains: Retail, Commercial or Corporate Banking or Capital Markets (propositions, channels, operations and technologies).

  • A proven track record in one or more of the following areas:

    • Leading complex programmes spanning technology, business and operations, with AI at the core

    • Delivering technology and AI solutions at pace, using Agile and hybrid delivery models

    • Defining and delivering operating models built for an AI age

    • Reinventing processes and driving operational excellence through data, automation and AI

    • Shaping payments strategy and modernising payments (e.g. real-time payments, ISO 20022)

    • Shaping technology and AI strategy and architecture

    • Supporting digital assets and tokenisation, and navigating regulatory change (e.g. DORA, AI regulation).

 

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

 

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

 

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. At Algolia, we're passionate about helping organisations create fast, relevant, and intuitive digital experiences. Algolia AI search powers millions of experiences across ecommerce, financial services, travel and hospitality, media, marketplaces, SaaS, and other enterprise applications.

 

As a Partner Solutions Engineer (EMEA), you'll play a critical role in expanding the impact of our partner ecosystem. You'll serve as the primary technical advisor across all of our partner categories including: Systems Integrators (SIs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Cloud Partners, OEM partners, and Resellers across the EMEA region, enabling them to build, sell, and deliver exceptional experiences powered by Algolia.

 

This role combines technical consulting, partner enablement, solution validation, and relationship management. You'll work closely with Partner Managers, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and the global Partner Solutions Engineering team to help partners become trusted experts on the Algolia platform.

 

While reporting into the global Solutions Engineering team, this role is dedicated to our Global Partner Team which covers our partners in EMEA, AMER, LATAM and APAC.  This is a chance to join a mature Partner Team which has delivered consistent results and value to the business for the past 5 years.

 

What You'll Do:

 

Enable and Empower Partners

  • Deliver technical onboarding and enablement programs for SI, ISV, and Cloud partners
  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for strategic partners throughout their lifecycle with Algolia
  • Provide ongoing technical guidance and best practices to ensure partners successfully implement and innovate using Algolia solutions.

Support Partner-Led Sales Opportunities

  • Provide presales technical expertise for opportunities coming from our partners
  • Assist partners with architecture discussions, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical discovery
  • Partner with Sales and Partner Managers to help accelerate partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue

 

Build Strategic Relationships

  • Develop trusted relationships with technical leaders and solution architects at strategic partner organizations
  • Serve as the voice of partners internally by communicating technical feedback and identifying opportunities for improvement
  • Collaborate closely with the global Partner Solutions Engineering organisation, particularly the EMEA team, to develop annual technical engagement initiatives and share best practices across regions

description: Wat ga je doen? Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn. Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s. Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders. Wat maakt deze rol uniek? In deze rol krijg je de kans om zichtbaar richting te geven aan de volgende groeifase van Voortman Steel Machinery. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en slagkracht samenkomen: ideeën worden niet alleen verkend, maar ook scherp getoetst op waardecreatie, rendement, risico en schaalbaarheid. CVC – Refroidissement et traitement d'air Production et distribution frigorifique. Groupes froids, free cooling et refroidissement adiabatique. CRAH, CRAC et Fan Walls. Systèmes de refroidissement liquide (Liquid Cooling). CDU et solutions de Direct-to-Chip Cooling. Optimisation des performances thermiques et énergétiques. Bâtiment et infrastructures Génie civil, structure et architecture. VRD et raccordements aux réseaux. Sécurité incendie et systèmes de détection/extinction. Contrôle d'accès, vidéosurveillance et sûreté physique. BMS, DCIM, GTB et supervision technique. Intégration des infrastructures IT et télécoms. Garantir le respect des plannings et des jalons contractuels. Piloter les interfaces entre génie civil, électricité, CVC et infrastructures IT. Superviser les procédures de contrôle qualité. Veiller au respect des exigences HSE. Gérer les modifications, non-conformités et situations critiques. Organiser les opérations préalables à la réception. E. description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold: 

  1. Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.
  2. Drive strategic engineering initiatives: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web. 

You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.

You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.

In this position, you will

Strategically:

  • Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace. We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job
  • Drive Technology Strategy: Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit. 
  • Refine the domain's identity: Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.

Tactically: 

  • Lead frontends: Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.
  • Lead Initiatives: Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.
  • Elevate global UI quality: Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.
  • Ensure Resilience & Reliability: Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.
  • Innovate & Optimize: Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.

A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.

About you

How much of a technical acumen? Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.

Leadership: you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority. 

Change horizon: You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.

What this role is not: This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.

We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.

We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.

description: You’re joining manda, iwoca’s M&A platform, at a pivotal moment. This is a 6-month fixed-term role for someone smart, hungry and entrepreneurial. With the right traction the role will convert into a permanent role at the forefront of manda’s growth efforts. The company Selling a small business is hard. Only one in five UK SME owners has a formal exit plan, yet half are counting on their business to fund their retirement. Below £10m in enterprise value, most M&A advisers can't make the economics work, so a generation of owner-managers is getting ready to step back with no realistic route to a sale. manda exists to fix that. We match owners with serious buyers, from search funds to private equity, and handle the whole process in one place, including financial due diligence and acquisition finance. Our first sale is done, and we're now opening manda up beyond iwoca's own customers. manda is part of iwoca, one of Europe's leading fintech lenders, which has provided more than £4 billion in funding to over 150,000 businesses since 2012. That gives us what a traditional adviser doesn't have: a deep footprint in the SME economy, a lender's data and infrastructure, and deals run on clean, automated processes rather than spreadsheets. You'll also work with iwoca's marketing & sales team and have access to their tools and know-how. The role Your mission is to grow the number of businesses manda takes to market, by finding owners who are serious about selling and bringing them into a first meeting with one of our Transaction Managers. With an ethos of smarter, not louder, you’ll build on iwoca’s existing models to work out which owners are getting ready to sell and which businesses will attract a buyer, then reach them personally by email, LinkedIn and phone. We'd rather approach the right few hundred owners well than the wrong ten thousand badly. Decide who we contact. Own the target lists and the logic behind them, and keep sharpening them on what actually predicts a seller and a strong business. Convert interest. Write and send the outreach yourself, follow up with owners who respond, and book them in with a Transaction Manager. Find what works. Run several experiments at once, back what produces meetings and drop what doesn't. Letters, events and ideas of your own can all earn a place. Make manda credible. Your messages are short, clear and human, the kind a busy owner actually answers, and you're just as at ease on the phone with someone who has spent thirty years building their business. You follow through. A reply that never becomes a meeting is a lead lost. You're honest about results. You'd rather report a bad week than dress it up. You're AI-savvy. description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. We’re looking for a Junior Technical Integration Manager in our Partnerships team (Hybrid in London, UK). Partners send us thousands of small businesses each month looking for finance, using our Lending API embedded in the apps those businesses already use. You’ll be the person who makes those integrations work: guiding partners’ developers through the build, fixing what breaks, and turning what partners need — and what we learn from them — into what we build next. You don’t need to arrive with extensive experience of debugging API’s, but you do need to be curious and open to learning whatever it takes to help partners. The team The Partnerships team puts iwoca’s lending inside the platforms small businesses already use — banking apps, accounting software, payment providers and comparison sites— through our Lending API. Partners range from recognisable global names to one-person businesses, and each one needs its integration to work differently. The team’s job is to grow those partnerships and to keep the journey from a partner’s app to a funded loan as short as it can be. You will also work very closely with our Partner Flow team, who build and maintain the Lending API and any features partners need. The role You’ll be the main contact for partners’ developers, helping them with all things API. You’ll need to be curious, meticulous, and happy working under your own steam. Mastery: become the person who knows the Lending API best Learn the Lending API end to end — every endpoint, webhook and failure mode. Guide a partner’s engineers from sandbox, to live and any ongoing optimisations. Shaping the integration they build along the way. Review partner customer journeys and tell them what to change to get more businesses funded. Triage live integration issues, trace them through the logs and code, and work with Partner Flow engineers on the fix. Influence: turn what partners tell you into what we build Own the technical relationship with each partner, from their engineers to their commercial leads. Pitch new API features to partners alongside our commercial team, and make the case for why they’d move the numbers. Be the partners’ voice inside iwoca — collect what they need and push it onto the roadmap. Ownership: run the systems the whole partner channel depends on Build the monitoring that tells us an integration is degrading before a partner has to tell us, then analyse and investigate what’s going wrong. Dig into integration performance data to find the problems nobody has reported yet. Own our public API documentation and make it the reason partners choose to build with us. The requirements Essential: A degree in a technical or scientific subject — computer science, engineering, maths, physics or similar An understanding and interest in how APIs work — enough to follow the logic in a partner’s integration. Clear, concise communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike, and the credibility to manage a partner’s expectations. An analytical approach that gets to the root of a problem, not just the symptom. Commercial sense to judge which problems, and which partners, are worth your time first. Comfortable using AI tools to investigate, analyse and get to answers faster. Bonus: Experience in a partner-facing or customer-facing technical role. Experience reading API documentation or debugging an integration yourself, even on a side project. Basic coding experience. The salary We expect to pay £32,500 - £37,500 (+20% quarterly OTE bonus) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. description: Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code. We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n. We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe. The Role You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them. In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows. You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering. Your First Six Months Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project. Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product. Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus. Who Will Thrive At Augustus We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits: American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low. Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment. Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team. Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent. This role is for you if: You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows. You’re a structured and relentless problem solver. You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to make complex processes simple. You have taste and care deeply about the quality of what you build. You leverage AI to push the boundaries of what a PM can do. You’re excited about building a programmable bank and helping shape what that means. Hard Requirements Experience end-to-end owning and building banking, fintech, or developer platform products. Technical enough to spar on architectural decisions with engineers - you're comfortable in API design discussions, not just UI reviews. You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, finance, or developer tools companies. You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple Comfortable in customer-facing roles - you've pitched, demoed, and closed early adopters yourself. Based in New York or Berlin, or willing to relocate. Pay transparency Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual US base salary range for this role is $180,000-$230,000 + equity. What We Offer Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before. Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities. Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner. Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget. Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team. Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. description: Tu sais faire avancer un produit. Et si tu allais plus loin ? Tu as déjà piloté des produits digitaux, arbitré des priorités parfois contradictoires et fait avancer des équipes Tech, Design et Business autour d'une vision commune ? Aujourd'hui, tu recherches de nouveaux défis, davantage d'impact et l'opportunité de développer ton expertise dans des environnements variés ? Chez Hubvisory, c'est exactement ce qu'on te propose ! Nous accompagnons de grands comptes dans leurs enjeux de Product Management et de transformation digitale. Notre conviction ? Un bon Product Manager ne se contente pas de gérer une roadmap. Il comprend les problèmes, prend des décisions et transforme les besoins utilisateurs en résultats concrets. 🎯 Ton terrain de jeu En tant que Product Manager consultant, tu interviens au cœur des équipes de nos clients pour faire avancer leurs produits digitaux, de la réflexion stratégique jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre. Concrètement, tu vas : 🔎 Comprendre avant de construire : explorer les besoins utilisateurs, mener des interviews, challenger les hypothèses et identifier les opportunités produit (Discovery, JTBD, personas, benchmarks). 🧩 Transformer les idées en expériences concrètes : collaborer avec les équipes Design et Tech sur les parcours utilisateurs, le prototypage et le story mapping. 🚀 Faire avancer le produit : construire et prioriser une roadmap, piloter le backlog et orchestrer le delivery en environnement agile. 📊 Mesurer ce qui compte vraiment : définir des KPI et OKR pertinents, suivre la performance et ajuster les décisions en fonction des résultats. 🤝 Faire entendre ta voix : conseiller les parties prenantes, challenger les demandes et embarquer les équipes autour des bonnes décisions produit. Ton rôle ne sera pas simplement de coordonner : tu seras là pour apporter une véritable expertise Product et créer de la valeur. ✨ Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? Parce que rejoindre Hubvisory, c'est intégrer un cabinet qui place le Product Management au cœur de son expertise, tout en cultivant l'apprentissage, l'ambition et l'esprit d'équipe. Ce qui t'attend : 📈 Une carrière qui évolue : des revalorisations salariales biannuelles et des perspectives vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil. 🧠 Une communauté d'experts : un environnement où partager, apprendre et progresser fait partie du quotidien. 💰 Un package attractif : rémunération fixe, variable, intéressement et congés payés supplémentaires. 💜 Des engagements concrets : signataire du Parental Challenge, Hubvisory propose notamment un arrêt fausse couche rémunéré à 100 % et le maintien de salaire à 100 % pendant les congés maternité et second parent. 🌍 Une entreprise engagée : plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022, avec la participation volontaire de 20 % des collaborateurs (mécénat de compétences, maraudes, Fresque du Climat…). Depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de cinq valeurs : expertise, apprentissage, ambition, bienveillance et méritocratie. Envie de donner une nouvelle dimension à ta carrière Product ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi ! 🚀 🔍 Le profil qu'on recherche Tu as 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en Product Management sur des produits digitaux et tu as déjà eu l'occasion de piloter des sujets de bout en bout. Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux du métier, mais surtout, tu sais les mettre en pratique dans des environnements exigeants. Côté Product, tu sais : Mener une Discovery structurée et transformer les besoins utilisateurs en opportunités concrètes. Construire une roadmap, prioriser un backlog et piloter le delivery en environnement agile. Collaborer efficacement avec les équipes Tech, Design et Business. Définir et suivre des KPI pour mesurer l'impact de tes décisions. Prendre du recul, challenger les demandes et arbitrer en fonction de la valeur business. Côté posture, tu fais la différence par : 🤝 Ton aisance relationnelle et ta capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs variés. 💡 Ton autonomie, ton esprit d'initiative et ta capacité à proposer des solutions. 🎯 Ton sens de l'analyse, ta rigueur et ton orientation résultats. 🚀 Ta curiosité et ton envie de progresser dans des contextes clients variés. Ce qu'on apprécie particulièrement ? Les Product Managers capables d'allier vision stratégique, sens du concret et intelligence collective. 💰 Rémunération 46 à 58 K€ brut annuel fixe + variable + intéressement. 🤝 Notre processus de recrutement Un processus transparent pour apprendre à se connaître et te permettre de te projeter : Échange avec un recruteur : ton parcours, tes motivations et tes attentes. Cas pratique Product en live avec un Manager (90 min) : pour découvrir ta manière de réfléchir et de résoudre des problématiques produit. Entretien avec un VP ou cofondateur (90 min) : pour échanger sur ta vision et tes ambitions. Closing et proposition d'embauche. Notre engagement : un retour sous 7 jours maximum, quelle que soit l'issue du processus. 🚀 Et maintenant ? Tu te reconnais dans cette description et tu as envie de relever de nouveaux défis Product ? description: 💡 Envie de construire des produits IA qui vont au-delà du POC ? L'intelligence artificielle transforme les usages, mais le véritable défi reste de concevoir des solutions utiles, performantes et capables de passer à l'échelle. Chez Hubvisory, nous accompagnons de grandes organisations dans la conception et le développement de produits digitaux à forte valeur ajoutée. Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Product Manager spécialisé(e) en IA pour imaginer, structurer et déployer des solutions innovantes, en combinant vision produit, compréhension technologique et impact business. 🎯 Ton rôle au quotidien Tu interviendras sur des projets stratégiques, de l'identification des opportunités jusqu'au déploiement des solutions. Tes principaux challenges : Identifier les opportunités IA : comprendre les enjeux business et utilisateurs pour faire émerger des cas d'usage pertinents. Définir la stratégie produit : construire et prioriser une roadmap cohérente, en intégrant les possibilités offertes par les LLM, le RAG et les agents IA. Passer de l'expérimentation à l'industrialisation : évaluer la faisabilité, anticiper les contraintes et garantir la création de valeur. Faire le lien entre métier et technologie : collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Engineering, Data et MLOps pour orienter les décisions produit. Mesurer la performance : définir les bons indicateurs, suivre l'adoption et optimiser les solutions en continu. Embarquer les parties prenantes : porter une vision claire, faciliter les arbitrages et accompagner le changement. Tu auras l'occasion d'évoluer dans des environnements exigeants, auprès de références telles que LVMH, Sephora, TF1 ou l'Urssaf. 🔎 Le profil que nous recherchons Nous recherchons avant tout un(e) Product Manager capable de connecter les enjeux business aux possibilités concrètes de l'intelligence artificielle. Ce qui fera la différence : Tu disposes de 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en Product Management, avec une expérience concrète sur des produits IA ou fortement orientés data. Les concepts de LLM, RAG, IA générative et systèmes agentiques te sont familiers. Tu sais travailler avec des équipes techniques, comprendre les grands principes d'une architecture IA et participer aux arbitrages sans nécessairement coder. description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before. Our Culture More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning. At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it. Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Role Description As a Real Estate Analyst at Checkout.com, you will provide dedicated administrative, data management, and operational support to the Head of Real Estate, focusing on mitigating risk and increasing efficiency across the global portfolio. This role is essential for managing high-risk operational tasks, such as lease event tracking, lease administration, budgeting and data reporting to ensure a structured approach and prevent critical errors. Key Responsibilities 1. Lease Administration & Governance Proactively track, monitor, and manage critical dates for all lease events, including renewals and break clauses, acting as the primary conduit for populating and managing the tools that host our Real Estate data. Support the execution of Real Estate contracts by coordinating with Brokers, Procurement, Legal etc. to finalise signing, updating project budgets, and archiving completed agreements. Manage operational risk by ensuring all key details related to lease obligations are accurately recorded, tracked and action is taken. For business case generation, gather comparable evidence, property valuations, and market data to drive strategic negotiations. Liaise with regional, business and central teams to capture the justification and data necessary for business case approval. Manage subleasing activities, including monitoring sub-tenant compliance, tracking sublease income and key milestones, and coordinating with legal and property management teams. 2. Financial and Procurement Reporting Coordinate with Finance, Tax and Procurement teams for Real Estate budgets, including updating and managing the Real Estate OPEX and CAPEX budget tracking tools. Act as the central point of contact for all property-related budget reporting, preparing quarterly reviews in a clear, digestible format that includes Real Estate and Workplace costs - giving an all inclusive cost per desk / square foot / head. Assist in reporting refurbishment or new office delivery costs, against business as usual spend for operational office locations. Support the coordination of financial and legal documentation required for transactions, such as preparing group structure charts and financials for external parties (e.g., landlords). 3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Data Collation Lead the coordination and collection of energy, water, and utility consumption data across the global portfolio to support future CSR reporting requirements. Manage the challenge of obtaining utility data in co-working and serviced spaces where direct meter readings are complex, including liaising with local teams, operators and landlords to gather the necessary information. Act as the conduit between the CEO Office and ESG/CSR teams to ensure our portfolio meets the needs of Sustainability policies and or regulatory requirements. 4. Departmental Administrative Support Assist in due diligence and preparation of business cases by researching and reporting on regional office statistics (e.g., desk counts, utilisation, attendance, capacity & commercials). Act as a key liaison for business case presentation and refinement. Maintain dynamic headcount forecasts to ensure space planning aligns with evolving business needs, particularly for high-growth regions. Monitor and document team shift patterns to inform workspace strategy (e.g., HVAC service requirements, after-hours access, and desk rotation models). Monitor and manage utilisation reports for Serviced Offices, along with onboard and offboard leaves to locations where we do not directly manage access control. Maintain the central digital repository for all property documentation (leases, contracts, floor plans, and insurance certificates), ensuring strict naming conventions, accessibility, and version control are met to ensure 100% audit-readiness. Schedule and prepare agendas, collate pre-read materials, and document meeting minutes for key real estate governance forums, proactively tracking action items to ensure timely closure by stakeholders. Managing the administrative aspects of the "joiner/leaver" process for office access where no assigned Workplace / People person is assigned. Act as the primary administrator for processing property-related invoices, performing the initial "first-pass" review to flag discrepancies against purchase orders (POs) and ensuring all costs are accurately coded before final submission to Finance. 5. Health, Safety & Physical Security Management Coordinate the global H&S audit schedule in partnership with SMEs, managing the central audit database, evidence library, action log, and training records to track progress and compliance. Support the weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting framework to surface risk trends and audit completion status, allocating audits to regional teams for execution. Own the scheduling, chasing, and evidence trail for the audit lifecycle, acting as the primary administrative point of contact to ensure smooth execution. Drive the audit lifecycle by ensuring all actions are identified, triaged, and managed to resolution, proactively identifying blockers and managing overdue items. Ensure regional teams interpret and apply the central H&S framework in accordance with local laws while maintaining the global baseline standards. Manage the integration of the H&S framework with wider Real Estate RACI to ensure clear accountability and prevent overlaps in responsibilities. Implement and maintain physical security policies and standards across all global office locations. Instruct periodic physical security risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security protocols. Oversee visitor management processes and physical security measures to safeguard personnel and assets. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team?
